description: This file contains the PHP source code for the Currency model class within the OpenCart admin localisation namespace. It provides methods for managing currency data such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving currency information from the database.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Model class for managing currencies in the OpenCart admin localisation namespace. Handles CRUD operations and retrieval for currency data.

methods.name: addCurrency
methods.description: Adds a new currency record to the database with provided data entries, invalidates the currency cache, and returns the last insert ID.

methods.name: editCurrency
methods.description: Updates an existing currency record identified by currency_id with provided data, then clears the cache.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the exchange value of a currency identified by its code, then clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteCurrency
methods.description: Removes a currency record from the database by currency_id and clears the cache.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific currency identified by its currency_id.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Fetches currency details based on its unique code.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Fetches a list of all currencies, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the total number of currency records in the database.
